svg.title: NewLifting: Video-based 2D-to-3D Human Pose Lifting Architecture
svg.desc: Editable architecture reconstruction with nine independently placed photo crops from the user-supplied reference. Orange HMR2 features enter the image-context K/V token group through a dedicated horizontal connection, then enter Joint-to-Image Cross-Attention through a separate upward arrow. Joint-token Q and self-attention Q/K/V are labeled independently. Text, diagram shapes, arrows, and all 67-joint skeletons remain editable vectors. Confidence reweighting applies only to spatial and temporal self-attention.
svg.text: NewLifting: Video-based 2D-to-3D Human Pose Lifting Architecture

g.text: (causal axis, before the first temporal block)
Confidence reweighting in Spatial and Temporal Self-Attention only
Early layers: confidence-dominant; deeper layers: progressively mask-uniform
(applied only to Spatial and Temporal Self-Attention, not to Joint-to-Image Cross-Attention)
